qG9Cjrs6jEkpaPoT_sCt6g.zh: 歐洲塞爾維亞拉什卡州(Raska)於7/28報告世界動物組織(WOAH) 今年首起動物疫情。養殖場132隻綿羊中,其中6隻出現症狀,全數已遭撲殺。該國農業部調查本次疫情可能經由科索沃非法走私管道傳入,當局已實施移動管制與撲殺補償,另強調無人畜共通傳染風險。
qG9Cjrs6jEkpaPoT_sCt6g.en: On 28 July, Raška District in Serbia, Europe, reported the first animal outbreak this year to WOAH (World Organisation for Animal Health). Of 132 sheep on the farm, 6 showed symptoms, and all of them have been culled. The Ministry of Agriculture investigated and found that the outbreak may have been introduced through illegal smuggling routes from Kosovo. Authorities have implemented movement controls and culling compensation, and stressed that there is no zoonotic transmission risk.

_tRvaos7CEzruzX-wOC23g.zh: 義大利疫情更新,今年迄今累計582例病例及39例死亡(CFR:15%),其中有260例病例發生侵犯神經系統症狀,病例主要分布於拉吉歐及坎帕亞大區。歐洲今年截至9/3,包括義大利、希臘、塞爾維亞、法國、羅馬亞、匈牙利、西班牙、阿爾巴亞及保加利亞等國均有報告本土病例。
_tRvaos7CEzruzX-wOC23g.en: Italy's outbreak update: so far this year, 582 cases and 39 deaths have been reported (CFR: 15%), of which 260 cases had neuroinvasive symptoms; cases are mainly in the Lazio and Campania regions. As of 3 September this year, locally acquired cases have been reported in Europe in several countries, including Italy, Greece, Serbia, France, Romania, Hungary, Spain, Albania and Bulgaria.
